summary.intent: Win the Lio 'Keep the Line Running' challenge at START Hack Munich by building a recheck-and-act procurement agent product (ask-soony) for Soony's launch, covering data analysis, product UX, supplier actions, phone alerts and demo readiness before the Sun 12:00 hand-in.
summary.outcome: Built and demoed a full product (Today/Launch/Routines/History pages, verifier, outbox, phone bridge) with all three demo stories rehearsed, merged PR #7 and #8, and split Felix/Maren sign-in and views; deck and video for the hand-in were still open and the heartbeat-gating fix was mid-way.

repo: Portal API has only /files, /files/{path} and /archive.zip; no webhooks, so change detection means polling and comparing SHA-256 (files get replaced under the same name).

Portal data is confidential and must stay gitignored under data/, yet the llm-task-update branch and PR #8 brought 335 data/portal files into main; they must be removed with git rm -r --cached data/portal (history keeps them).
Approving cards on live data sends real supplier emails, so tests and experiments must run on state copies or the demo instance (ASK_MAIL_DRY=on).
Live server on :8000 and demo on :8001 run from the main folder; switching branches there would swap code underneath them, so other branches go in a git worktree (../ask-soony-llm-task-update).
CSV exports can be cp1252 with ; delimiters (German PO export); read_csv and verifier adapters now fall back to cp1252 and sniff delimiters.
Outbox sync must append under api._lock or it overwrites concurrent actions; replies to side emails must default to status open.
Entire only checkpoints when repo files change, and the repo requires entire status and entire brain status checks before pushing.

code.finding: read_csv decodes utf-8-sig with cp1252 fallback; approve has a 409 duplicate guard; activity items now record who decided and keep up to 200 entries.
pick() must split comma words and treat 'supplier' as an email option; expire_stale proposals avoid 'not an open card' failures.
Realtime calls use semantic VAD, avoid concurrent responses and reconnect the sideband twice.

workflow: Check the files in data first: the subagent cross-check of 200 order confirmations and 59 scans found the real discrepancies (80,000 vs 8,000 art books, failed statue lot).
Keep specific questions for credibility but lead office hours with pain and product questions.
Use a git worktree to pull a teammate's branch without disturbing running servers.
Never open PRs or push without being asked; user-run pushes happen separately.

friction: The demo background loop does not auto-raise call alerts; card_alerts.tick must be run manually.
Realtime phone call cut off due to background noise, concurrent response errors and a sideband ConnectionClosed.
Outbox sync race lost the 07:58 art book approval twice.
Paper check crashed on the cp1252 German PO export.
PR #8 had a test-file conflict and 936 changed files because the branch was based on an older main; it was merged with data included.
Heartbeat showed 'Not checked since 08:30' on a server where polling was not enabled, requiring a flag gating fix.
Demo DNS CNAME initially pointed to the wrong tunnel.
open_items: Remove 335 portal data files from main (git rm -r --cached data/portal) and decide on the stored readings and golden.json.
Restart live :8000 and demo servers to pick up Farhan's reading baseline and the new sign-in split, and push main commits 08c0d12 and 02ce204 (awaiting user OK).
Finish heartbeat gating on the polling flag, rebuild and verify; new pages not yet viewed in a browser.
Build the 6-slide deck and record the 3-minute video for the 12:00 hand-in.
Fix demo background loop not auto-raising call alerts; switch OpenAI webhook back to https://ask-soony.stenglein.dev/hooks/openai after the demo.
Delete duplicate routine 'Ask Hamburg to count book stock' on live; optional notes to Hwaseong and Lucas.
